response.answer: Success rates are essentially flat. The last 7 days (Oct 25 to Oct 31) show an 88.45% success rate (101,587 of 114,846 attempts), versus 88.63% in the prior 7 days (Oct 18 to Oct 24; 102,154 of 115,254 attempts). That is a small dip of about 0.18 percentage points, with attempt volume roughly unchanged.
